title: Tiny, cute book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- Book body base shadow -->
    <rect x='20' y='30' width='60' height='44' rx='6' fill='#8a2be2'/>
    <!-- Left cover -->
    <rect x='22' y='28' width='28' height='46' rx='4' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
    <!-- Right cover -->
    <rect x='50' y='28' width='28' height='46' rx='4' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
    <!-- Spine -->
    <rect x='46' y='26' width='8' height='50' rx='3' fill='#d6336c'/>
    <!-- Pages left -->
    <rect x='27' y='32' width='20' height='38' rx='2' fill='#fff6e0'/>
    <!-- Pages right -->
    <rect x='53' y='32' width='20' height='38' rx='2' fill='#fff6e0'/>
    <!-- Page lines left -->
    <rect x='30' y='38' width='14' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
    <rect x='30' y='45' width='14' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
    <rect x='30' y='52' width='10' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
    <!-- Page lines right -->
    <rect x='56' y='38' width='14' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
    <rect x='56' y='45' width='14' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
    <rect x='56' y='52' width='10' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
    <!-- Cute bookmark ribbon -->
    <path d='M68 26 L68 40 L72 35 L76 40 L76 26 Z' fill='#4ecdc4'/>
    <!-- Little smiley face on cover corner -->
    <circle cx='36' cy='66' r='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='65' r='0.8' fill='#8a2be2'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='65' r='0.8' fill='#8a2be2'/>
    <path d='M34 68 Q36 70 38 68' stroke='#8a2be2' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Heart on spine -->
    <path d='M50 40 C50 37, 47 37, 47 40 C47 43, 50 45, 50 45 C50 45, 53 43, 53 40 C53 37, 50 37, 50 40 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  </g>
</svg>
